is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles gambiae complex and Anopheles funestus group mosquitoes in Ghana.

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper reports genotyping for Vgsc L995F (kdr-west) in Anopheles gambiae s.s. (Table 3).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 3 provides genotype counts (RR, RS, SS) for the L1014F (L995F) mutation across four localities.

african_field_population.evidence: The mosquitoes were collected from four mining sites in Ghana (Obuasi, Tarkwa, Ahafo, Akyem).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an original empirical study reporting baseline entomological data from field surveys.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study specifies four distinct mining localities in Ghana: Obuasi, Tarkwa/Damang, Ahafo, and Akyem.

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Collection dates are specified for each site (e.g., Obuasi July 2010; Tarkwa May 2007/March 2009; Ahafo Dec 2006/June 2008; Akyem June 2006).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study reports new field collections conducted by the authors.

supplement.evidence: All necessary data, including genotype counts and bioassay results, are provided in the main text tables.

assessment.summary: This study reports insecticide resistance and kdr (L1014F) frequencies in Anopheles gambiae s.l. and Anopheles funestus from four mining areas in Ghana. High levels of pyrethroid resistance and kdr mutations were observed.
